items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: The name 'John Fielsing' appears only in a parenthetical note by the interviewer/producer, not in the interviewee's spoken response.

ctx.x: I was talking a little bit to Snub Mosley about that, and Snub said they did come to New York and, but just...I think they were playing theaters or something, and they were asked... Meyer Davis asked them to come into the Arcadia which was competition to the Roseland and he said Trent didn't want to do it because he was afraid of losing his men. He thought

if they were in New York too long the good guys would be, you know... which Snub said they wouldn't do because they all loved Trent and they would have stayed with him, but he was kind of nervous about that, so instead they, you know, went on...
